_note: The OFFICIAL provenance tier exists in the model but is deliberately empty. This prototype has no integration with the Department of Tourism, and no official visitor figure is generated in place of one. The government interface shows this as an explicit not connected state rather than substituting synthetic data. See CLAUDE.md section 9.
